title: 2024 CMO Problems/Problem 5
text:
Let \( p \) be a given prime number, and let \( f \) be a bijection from the set \( \{0,1,\dots,p-1\} \) to itself. Suppose \( f \) satisfies that whenever \( p \mid a^2 - b \), we have \( |f(a) - f(b)| \leq 2024 \).

Prove that there exist infinitely many primes \( p \) for which such a bijection \( f \) exists, and also infinitely many primes \( p \) for which no such bijection \( f \) exists.
